from openpyxl import load_workbook
from math import isnan
path='inputs/JuliaJong_CRISPRa_BCL2_B3GNT_cacerResTcellCytotoxicity_supplData1_mageck.xlsx'

    break

    a=row[i1]; b=row[i2]

        bad += 1
        continue
    try:
        af=float(a); bf=float(b)

        bad += 1; continue

print('n', len(x), 'bad', bad, 'minmax', (min(x),max(x)), (min(y),max(y)))

    s1=pd.Series(x)
    s2=pd.Series(y)

from openpyxl import load_workbook
from math import sqrt
path='inputs/JuliaJong_CRISPRa_BCL2_B3GNT_cacerResTcellCytotoxicity_supplData1_mageck.xlsx'
wb=load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
ws=wb['MAGeCK P-values']
header=next(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
i1=header.index('Chronic Round1 S1')
i2=header.index('Chronic Round1 S2')
x=[]; y=[]
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    x.append(float(row[i1]))
    y.append(float(row[i2]))

def average_ranks(values):
    n=len(values)
    order=sorted(range(n), key=values.__getitem__)
    ranks=[0.0]*n
    i=0
    while i<n:
        j=i+1
        v=values[order[i]]
        while j<n and values[order[j]] == v:
            j += 1
        # ranks are 1-based; average of i+1 through j
        avg=(i+1 + j)/2.0
        for k in range(i,j):
            ranks[order[k]]=avg
        i=j
    return ranks
rx=average_ranks(x)
ry=average_ranks(y)
n=len(rx)
mx=sum(rx)/n
my=sum(ry)/n
num=sum((a-mx)*(b-my) for a,b in zip(rx,ry))
den=sqrt(sum((a-mx)**2 for a in rx)*sum((b-my)**2 for b in ry))
r=num/den
print(n)
print(format(r, '.17g'))
print(format(r, '.15f'))
# tie counts diagnostic
print('unique', len(set(x)), len(set(y)))

from openpyxl import load_workbook
from math import sqrt
path='inputs/JuliaJong_CRISPRa_BCL2_B3GNT_cacerResTcellCytotoxicity_supplData1_mageck.xlsx'
wb=load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
ws=wb['MAGeCK P-values']
header=next(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
cols=[header.index('Chronic Round1 S1'), header.index('Chronic Round1 S2')]
pairs=[(float(r[cols[0]]), float(r[cols[1]])) for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True)]

def ranks(vals):
    sorted_vals=sorted((v,i) for i,v in enumerate(vals))
    out=[None]*len(vals)
    pos=0
    while pos < len(sorted_vals):
        end=pos+1
        while end < len(sorted_vals) and sorted_vals[end][0] == sorted_vals[pos][0]:
            end += 1
        rank=(pos+1 + end)/2
        for _,idx in sorted_vals[pos:end]:
            out[idx]=rank
        pos=end
    return out
rx, ry = ranks([p[0] for p in pairs]), ranks([p[1] for p in pairs])
# Pearson via centered sums; sample/pop denominator cancels.
mx=sum(rx)/len(rx); my=sum(ry)/len(ry)
ssx=sum((v-mx)*(v-mx) for v in rx)
ssy=sum((v-my)*(v-my) for v in ry)
sp=sum((a-mx)*(b-my) for a,b in zip(rx,ry))
print(sp/(ssx*ssy)**0.5)
PY"
